newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe shares firmer but trade muted.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe shares firmer but trade muted.

text.p: Zimbabwean shares ended the largely firmer on Friday but brokers said trade during the day was fairly thin on the whole.

"Not much happened today. There was a lot of interest on the new issue Randalls and that's where most of the money is going at the moment. So the market should continue up and down until Randalls is listed," one broker said.
The key 57-counter industrial index edged 35.11 points higher to close at 10,362.61 and was 61.94 points stronger on the on the week.

Shares to advance on Friday included hotel giant Meikles which put on 100 cents to 2,700, timber producer Border which added 100 cents to 1,050 and blue chip conglomerate Delta which went up 15 cents to 1,725.
Tea and coffee grower Tanganda at 500 and seed company Seedco at 285 were both 10 cents firmer while new listing CFI gained nine cents to 195.
The secondary seven-counter mining index lost 2.39 points to 991.31 with most counters trading unchanged while gold firm Falgold lost five cents to 70. The index shed 1.93 points on the week.
